ValidationRule.description: Validates that docs can't be sent out on Renewal deals with points less than 5. Allows for manual exception. --> Removing validation on 8/27 to support renewals to DLP.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
( ISCHANGED( WC_Buy_Rate__c ) || ISCHANGED( Ratio__c ) )&&
Date_on_Docs__c >= DATE(2015,12,16)&&
( ISPICKVAL(Type,'RENEWAL') || ISPICKVAL(Type,'RENEWAL CONCURRENT') )&&
(( VALUE(Ratio__c)- WC_Buy_Rate__c)*100<5 )&&
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Lauren"), ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Kyle"), ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Johnny"), ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Justin"), ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Nikki"), ISPICKVAL(Renewal_Points_Exception__c, "Approved by Andra") ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Points on Renewals must be greater than 5 to send docs out. If this is a Direct Renewal, submit for Points Exception to the Renewals Manager.
